topics.title: Your topics
topics.description: A few times a day Isoform names what you are into from what it already summarized on this computer over the last two weeks: your activity summaries, your goals, what it learned about you, chat titles, your web searches, and the products and tools you looked into. To name them, it sends those summaries to the same assistant that writes them, and it never keeps people's names. Until it has named any, it shows phrases from your titles instead. To look for new things, only each topic's name and a few short search phrases made from it are sent to a web search: the web search of your Claude Code when it is signed in on this computer, otherwise Grok, Gemini or Doubao in your signed-in Chrome. Picked for you sends your top six topic names the same way. All of this happens only while this is on, Watch my screen is on and observing is not paused. The summaries, pages, files and windows themselves are not sent to the search.
